User teams hold every spot from No. 1 through No. 13. Week 2 is already serving up 75, 69 and 66 points before the rest of the schedule kicks off.

The opening week

Close calls, then fireworks

Mizzou’s 37–34 win over South Carolina and Nick’s 30–27 escape at Tulsa were the narrowest verified user results. Grenix followed with a 38–31 win at BYU. Every one of those games finished within a possession.

Big Nolan introduced Kansas with a 70–7 demolition of Oklahoma State. teezy matched the 70-point mark against Missouri State, and jetlife’s Auburn hung 68 on Middle Tennessee. TeScoopzOfWhey’s Washington opened 56–3 against Fresno State; Jackpot’s Texas Tech dropped 52 on Kansas State.

The rest of the verified board is below. The capture did not corroborate a Week 1 result or bye for 11 users; those remain unreported.

The current week

Week 2 is already off the rails

Week 2 was supposed to be the preview section. A large chunk of the league apparently did not get the memo. Cole’s No. 7 Nebraska erased Miami (OH) 75–0; jetlife’s No. 1 Auburn hammered Air Force 69–3; Lando Bando’s Colorado ran past Northwestern 66–20. Jackpot and No. 17 Texas Tech rolled North Texas 59–14, while Michael and No. 9 Virginia blanked FCS East 58–0.
